name: building-907
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from the street west-south-west of the building, about 27 m from the annex's corner nearest it, through a lens of about 72 degrees across, looking up 6.5 degrees; its camera is fitted to the annex's two corners on its south-south-west face (their tops and feet, and both as verticals) and the vault's crown on the hall's west-north-west end, held 1.6 m over the LiDAR's ground (1.86 m fitted)

building.title: Building 907 (907), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 907's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 907 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

aerial.licence: Auckland Central 0.06 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023): sourced from LINZ and licensed by Auckland Council for re-use under CC BY 4.0

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above and tower_above 9 m over the provisional ground: the frame is the top of the hall's barrel vault, whose crown stands about 10 m over the ground and its eaves about 6.5 m, and the annex (7.5 to 8 m) is left out; the centre is that top's, the axis its principal axis (axis_from left out), bearing 284.90 deg, along the vault: within 0.24 deg of its crown line fitted to the LiDAR (285.13 deg), and the eaves keep their distance from it to 0.1 m along the hall. The walls axis is not used: on this roof it gave 287.7 deg, along which the eaves drift 1 m over 30 m. x runs along the vault toward its east-south-east end, z faces south-south-west, toward the annex

ground_note: 53.19 m: the median LiDAR ground (class 2) in the first crop, 25 m round the outline (p5 52.22, p95 54.06); provisional, to be the LiDAR's ground at the door (step 7)
crop_note: 45 m round the outline, so that the crop box takes in the street west-south-west of the annex where the photograph is taken (25 m left its camera outside, with no LiDAR ground under it to hold its height)
